title: Add OCA provider
author: supreethjavalli
lessons: Bot security reviews are valuable but insufficient -- kiloconnect correctly found PKCE/SecretStorage/DOMPurify but missed type error, test gap, and i18n absence
Provider PRs need a checklist gate for tests, changeset, i18n, and shared component isolation
OAuth providers introduce state (token lifecycle) that requires higher test bar than stateless API-key providers
TypeScript satisfies in switch defaults catches exhaustiveness bugs -- oca in both case and satisfies is an immediate red flag

test_results.test: CI FAIL: test-extension fails on ubuntu and windows; unit-test skipped

bot_findings.kiloconnect: approve at 95% confidence (good security review, missed structural issues)
